name: shellysvn
description: A standalone Subversion client for macOS, Windows, and Linux

scripts.build:unpack: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries current && electron-builder --dir
scripts.build:win: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries win32-x64 && electron-builder --win
scripts.build:mac: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries darwin-x64 darwin-arm64 && electron-builder --mac
scripts.build:mac-universal: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries darwin-x64 darwin-arm64 && electron-builder --mac --universal
scripts.build:linux: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries linux-x64 && electron-builder --linux
scripts.build:linux-appimage: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries linux-x64 && electron-builder --linux AppImage
scripts.build:linux-deb: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries linux-x64 && electron-builder --linux deb
scripts.build:linux-rpm: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries linux-x64 && electron-builder --linux rpm
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries all && electron-builder --win --mac --linux
scripts.release: bun run build && bun run verify:binaries all && electron-builder
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:boundaries && bun run check:remote-assets && bun run test:skips && bun run test:unit && bun run build
